description: Copy entities, offset by [dx, dy, dz], into the same space as the originals, atomically and in memory. Keeps layer, color and linetype. Works on LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POINT, 3DFACE, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, ELLIPSE and SOLID; other types (SPLINE and HATCH included), and block references that carry attributes, are refused by name. Returns the new handles in input order.
name: cad.copy_entities
